property_summary: For any caller and any new owner, calling transferOwnership can only ever leave the contract owned by someone other than the caller-controlled value unless the caller is the actual owner; the mutant deletes the onlyOwner check, so an arbitrary non-owner can set owner() to any fuzzed address.
change_summary: Delete the _checkOwner() call in the onlyOwner modifier so guarded functions like transferOwnership can be invoked by any caller, altering the resulting owner state.
